components.name: DataTable
components.description:
DataTable components are used to represent a collection of resources,
displaying a subset of their fields in columns, or headers. We prioritize
direct updates to the state of what we're rendering, so internally we
normalize the given data and then denormalize it at render time. Each part of
the DataTable is accessible through look-up by ID, and updating the state of
a single entity cascades updates to the consumer.

props.name: filterRows
props.type: (options: { cellsById: Record<string, DataTableCell<ColTypes>>; getCellId: (rowId: string, header: string) => string; headers: DataTableHeader[]; inputValue: string; rowIds: string[]; }) => string[]

components.name: FeatureFlags
components.description:
Supports an object of feature flag values with the `flags` prop, merging them
along with the current `FeatureFlagContext` to provide consumers to check if
a feature flag is enabled or disabled in a given React tree

props.name: filterItems
props.type: (items: readonly ItemType[], extra: { inputValue: string; itemToString: (item: ItemType) => string; }) => ItemType[]

components.name: HeaderGlobalAction
components.description:
HeaderGlobalAction is used as a part of the `HeaderGlobalBar`. It is
essentially an Icon Button with an additional state to indicate whether it is
"active". The active state comes from when a user clicks on the global action
which should trigger a panel to appear.

Note: children passed to this component should be an Icon.

components.name: Layer
components.description:
A custom hook that will return information about the current layer. A common
field to pull from this is the `level` for the layer that the component that
calls this hook is currently in

components.name: NumberInput
components.description:
Converts a string with any Unicode numeral system to a JavaScript number.
Handles all numeral systems supported by Intl.NumberFormat.

components.name: SideNavFooter
components.description:
SideNavFooter is used for rendering the button at the bottom of the side
navigation that is a part of the UI Shell. It is responsible for handling the
user interaction to expand or collapse the side navigation.

components.name: Stack
components.description:
The Stack component is a useful layout utility in a component-based model.
This allows components to not use margin and instead delegate the
responsibility of positioning and layout to parent components.

In the case of the Stack component, it uses the spacing scale from the
Design Language in order to determine how much space there should be between
items rendered by the Stack component. It also supports a custom `gap` prop
which will allow a user to provide a custom value for the gap of the layout.

This component supports both horizontal and vertical orientations.

Inspiration for this component:

- https://paste.twilio.design/layout/stack/
- https://github.com/Workday/canvas-kit/blob/f2f599654876700f483a1d8c5de82a41315c76f1/modules/labs-react/layout/lib/Stack.tsx

components.name: Theme
components.description: Specify the theme to be applied to a page, or a region in a page

props.name: onChange
props.type: (selection: T, name: string, evt: unknown) => void

components.name: Toggletip
components.description:
Used as a container for the button and content of a toggletip. This component
is responsible for coordinating between interactions with the button and the
visibility of the content

components.name: ToggletipActions
components.description:
`ToggletipActions` is a container for one or two actions present at the base
of a toggletip. It is used for layout of these items.

components.name: ToggletipButton
components.description:
`ToggletipButton` controls the visibility of the Toggletip through mouse
clicks and keyboard interactions.

components.name: ToggletipContent
components.description:
`ToggletipContent` is a wrapper around `PopoverContent`. It places the
`children` passed in as a prop inside of `PopoverContent` so that they will
be rendered inside of the popover for this component.

components.name: ToggletipLabel
components.description: Used to render the label for a Toggletip
